text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx from inference-proxy-az1a region for redwood-inference-prod - error spike + connection resets. Auto-page to oncall-sre.

maria (oncall): seeing a lot of econnreset on the proxy fleet in az1a, p95 latency jumped to 1.2s and 5xx rate ~8% for the last 2m.

chen (sre): copying logs now. any recent deploys to proxy or iptables changes?

maria (oncall): no deploys in last 30m, release bot shows last infra deploy ~2h ago.

zoe (network): checking AZ control plane, DNS query latency is also elevated from az1a to resolver cluster, plus some TCP retransmits. Could be noisy host uplink.

maria (oncall): tagging @tim and @chen for mitigation options. Customers reporting latency and some failures on streaming endpoints.

luis (support): heads-up: two enterprise customers opened support cases reporting intermittent timeouts on text-gen routes. I told them we're investigating and will provide ETA.

chen (sre): root cause hypothesis: proxy processes hitting memory pressure -> OOMkill or heavy GC -> connections resetting -> upstream inference backpressure -> client 502/504. Need to confirm OOM events on proxy instances.

maria (oncall): running quick check on instance metrics: top OOM events on proxy-az1a-*-fleet, RSS spikes, swap activity.

ops-bot: deploy-check: no recent proxy binary changes found. Autoscaler: az1a proxy ASG at 95% CPU.

tim (eng-infra): immediate mitigations we can try: 1) gracefully drain a subset of proxy nodes and restart proxy process 2) shift 15-25% of traffic to az1b/azc via routing policy 3) temporary model-variant fallback to smaller context to reduce memory. Which order?

maria (oncall): do 1 and 2 in parallel. Start surgical restart on 3 instances (not full ASG) to avoid mass churn. I'll start restart now.

chen (sre): command I'll run on three hosts:
```bash
for h in proxy-az1a-12 proxy-az1a-17 proxy-az1a-29; do
  ssh $h 'sudo systemctl restart redwood-proxy && sleep 5 && journalctl -u redwood-proxy -n 50' &
done
```

maria (oncall): restart started. pulling logs.

zoe (network): executing routing nudge: updating traffic-split policy for inference-prod from az1a:100 -> az1a:75 az1b:25, TTL 60s, gradual over 60s.

ops-bot: routing-change applied: inference-prod split policy updated (az1b receives 25% now).

maria (oncall): after first restart p95 latency dropped to 420ms, 5xx down to 3.2%. connection resets decreased. Good sign.

chen (sre): OOM logs: container runtime killed redwood-proxy on two hosts due to RSS spike ~1.9GiB. Looks like a specific code path (KV cache growth + long-lived streams) causing memory retention.

tim (eng-infra): pushing quick config change: reduce max-prefetch and lower stream buffer for proxies in az1a via feature flag so proxy memory usage reduces. Will roll to 30% of hosts first.

maria (oncall): apply flag to canary group.

ops-bot: feature-flag rollout: proxy-stream-buffer-reduction -> canary hosts (az1a-proxy-10..15).

maria (oncall): canary results look good, memory usage down ~35% on canary hosts, no new OOMs in last 90s.

luis (support): updating customers: short note sent that we mitigated and are monitoring; will follow up with timeline.

zoe (network): DNS resolver latency also improving after traffic shift. There was a localized resolver thread limit hit in az1a. We will open ticket with cloud provider if it recurs.

chen (sre): next steps: 1) keep reduced stream buffer flag on for 1h, 2) gradually restart remaining pressure hosts (stagger 30s), 3) revert routing split when az1a healthy, 4) run postmortem and investigate KV cache retention bug.

maria (oncall): agree. initiating staggered restarts and flag rollout to remaining hosts now.

ops-bot: staggered restart: queued 12 hosts, interval 30s.

maria (oncall): after roll + routing shift p95 is 210ms and 5xx <0.5% across prod, error budget unaffected for most customers. Confirming with support: no new customer reports.

tim (eng-infra): creating emergency PR ticket for config default change and a follow-up to address long-term fix in proxy memory management.

maria (oncall): creating incident page and status update draft for status.redwood.ai: brief outage affecting az1a only, mitigation in place, cross-az traffic rerouted, ETA for full recovery 30-60m.

luis (support): posted external status update and CC'd affected account reps.

zoe (network): raising cloud ticket for resolved resolver saturation and asking for limit bump or guidance.

chen (sre): logging actions into incident system and assigning postmortem owners: chen (primary), tim (infra), zoe (network).

maria (oncall): oncall handoff at +2h if still open. For now marking incident as mitigated and monitoring for 30m. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, error rates reduced. P95 latency back to normal. Incident state: mitigated.

maria (oncall): leaving final note: root cause likely combination of local resolver saturation + proxy memory regression under specific streaming load. Full RCA will include memory heap profile, KV cache growth tracing, and DNS capacity review.

chen (sre): adding evidence: attached logs and heap dumps to incident ticket.

luis (support): will follow up with customers with postmortem link when available.

ops-bot: Incident closed to P0 after 45m of stable metrics; will reopen if regressions detected.

maria (oncall): thanks team. good coordinated run. :bow:
